List the available warehouse modules

Source: R/dw_modules.R
dw_modules.Rd

Module definitions ship as data under inst/extdata/modules/, one YAML file per module, rather than as R code. They change independently of the code that executes them, they carry a description of the SAS block each one ports, and holding them outside R source is what keeps site-specific identifiers out of this repository — the SQL ships with placeholders and the real warehouse, schema, and cohort names arrive from study.yaml at run time.

Usage

dw_modules()

Value

A data frame with one row per module and columns module, output, join_key, and optional.

Examples

dw_modules()
#>                  module   output join_key optional
#> base               base   bdbase masterid    FALSE
#> echo               echo     echo    patid     TRUE
#> events           events bdevents    patid     TRUE
#> fup                 fup      fup    patid    FALSE
#> vitalstatus vitalstatus   bdstat masterid    FALSE
